text: Which budget is used for contract changes that there was no time to plan into the performance budget?
options: The undistributed budget.
The scheduled work budget.
The management reserve.
The unallocated budget.
The distributed budget.
explanation: Undistributed budget — бюджет изменений контракта, которые из-за нехватки времени ещё не включили в performance budget. Unallocated относится к ещё не идентифицированным/не авторизованным задачам, а management reserve — другой резерв. Это точное разграничение из Lecture 4.

text: Which approach to project problems does the earned value measurement system emphasize?
options: Using the management reserve for each variance.
Moving overruns into the undistributed budget.
Correcting variances in large steps at milestones.
Reviewing performance only at project closure.
Finding and solving problems before they grow.
explanation: EVMS замечает отклонения рано, когда их проще исправить небольшими действиями. Перенос перерасхода в другой бюджет не решает проблему; проверка только при закрытии уже слишком поздняя.

text: How are formal groups created in an organization?
options: By management decision, for organizational goals.
By employees who share interests or friendships.
By the customer, to review the project deliverables.
From people who work near each other.
By the members themselves, to meet social needs.
explanation: Formal group создаёт руководство ради целей организации. Дружба, общие интересы и близость рабочих мест объясняют informal groups, поэтому B, D и E не подходят; заказчик не является общим правилом создания формальных групп.

text: Which term describes the power, often given by position, to make final decisions?
options: Hierarchical referral.
Accountability.
Direct contact.
Authority.
Responsibility.
explanation: Authority — право принимать окончательные решения. Responsibility — обязанность выполнить работу, accountability — отвечать за её удовлетворительное завершение. Direct contact и hierarchical referral — способы координации.

text: What determines whether a matrix structure is strong or weak?
options: How many projects report to the general manager.
How large the project budget is compared with others.
Whether staff remain loyal to their functional units.
Who has more influence over workers' daily performance.
Whether a liaison department handles engineering changes.
explanation: Сила матрицы определяется влиянием PM по сравнению с функциональным руководителем, особенно на ежедневную работу сотрудников. Размер бюджета и число проектов сами по себе не определяют strong/weak matrix.

text: The matrix form tries to combine the advantages of which two structures?
options: Product and task force structures.
Functional and line-staff structures.
Pure functional and product structures.
Line-staff and liaison structures.
Task force and departmental structures.
explanation: Матрица сочетает pure functional и product/projectized структуры: техническую специализацию подразделений и ориентацию на результат проекта. Другие пары не дают именно этого сочетания.

text: In the Agile Manifesto, which item is valued more than comprehensive documentation?
options: Contract negotiation.
Working software.
Individuals and interactions.
Customer collaboration.
Responding to change.
explanation: В этой паре ценностей Manifesto работающий продукт важнее исчерпывающей документации. Остальные ценности существуют в других парах; вопрос просит конкретно пару к comprehensive documentation.

text: What does the Japanese word "Kanban" mean?
options: Bottleneck.
Waste.
Workflow.
Signboard.
Iteration.
explanation: Kanban буквально означает signboard — вывеска/визуальная карточка. Workflow — то, что доска помогает увидеть, waste — потери, iteration — итерация; это не перевод слова.

text: Which agile approach is a family of customized methods that classifies projects by criticality and team size?
options: Kanban.
Crystal.
Feature-Driven Development.
Extreme Programming.
DSDM.
explanation: Crystal — семейство методов, которые подбирают под размер команды и критичность системы. XP узнаётся по инженерным практикам, FDD — по features, Kanban — по потоку и WIP, DSDM — по своим восьми принципам.

text: Which Scrum value is needed to take on difficult problems and do what is right, even when it is uncomfortable?
options: Courage.
Focus.
Openness.
Respect.
Commitment.
explanation: Courage — смелость решать сложные проблемы и поступать правильно, даже когда некомфортно. Focus — концентрация, openness — открытость, respect — уважение, commitment — приверженность цели.

text: Which question does the first topic of Sprint Planning answer?
options: What went well in the last Sprint?
What was achieved in the Sprint?
How will the chosen work get done?
What can be Done this Sprint?
Why is this Sprint valuable?
explanation: Sprint Planning начинает с WHY — зачем Sprint ценен. После этого обсуждают WHAT можно сделать и HOW выполнить работу. Вопросы о прошлом Sprint относятся к Review или Retrospective.

text: In Scrum, which commitment belongs to the Product Backlog?
options: The Increment.
The Product Goal.
The Sprint Backlog.
The Sprint Goal.
The Definition of Done.
explanation: Product Backlog связан с Product Goal; Sprint Backlog — со Sprint Goal; Increment — с Definition of Done. В ответах смешаны артефакты и commitments: выбирай обязательство нужного артефакта.

text: Which persona element explains how and why the intended user interacts with the solution?
options: Differentiators.
Needs.
Motivations.
Traits and characteristics.
Name and image.
explanation: Motivations описывают, как и почему пользователь взаимодействует с решением. Needs — конкретные потребности, traits — характеристики, differentiators — отличие от других персон.

text: Which INVEST criterion means the way a story is delivered is not fixed in advance and can be discussed with the team?
options: Valuable.
Testable.
Negotiable.
Estimable.
Independent.
explanation: Negotiable означает, что детали реализации обсуждаются, а карточка не является замороженным контрактом. Valuable — польза, Testable — проверяемость, Estimable — возможность оценки, Independent — независимость.

text: Which three elements make up the 3Cs of user stories?
options: Conversation, Contract and Commitment.
Customer, Card and Criteria.
Collaboration, Content and Confirmation.
Card, Commitment and Collaboration.
Card, Conversation and Confirmation.
explanation: 3Cs: Card, Conversation, Confirmation. Карточка фиксирует краткую идею, разговор уточняет смысл, подтверждение задаёт проверку принятия. Contract и Commitment в эту тройку не входят.

text:
Scenario: An e-government portal project in Astana had accurate initial estimates, but nobody updated the forecast of what the unfinished modules would cost. In month 10 the team discovered the remaining work needed twice the money left.
Question: Which requirement of an effective control system was missing?
options: Thorough planning of the work to be performed.
Periodic re-estimation of cost to complete.
Good initial estimating of time, labor and costs.
A disciplined budget and authorization of expenditures.
Clear communication of the scope of required tasks.
explanation: Начальные оценки были хорошими, но прогноз оставшейся работы не пересматривался. Поэтому отсутствует periodic re-estimation of cost to complete, а не исходное планирование или разрешение расходов.

text:
Scenario: After the plan for a tax-system upgrade is approved, the project manager issues a signed work order that releases funds so the database team can start its work package.
Question: To which phase of the operating cycle does this activity belong?
options: Work authorization and release.
Cost data collection and reporting.
Cost analysis.
Reporting to customer and management.
Variance at completion forecasting.
explanation: Подписанный work order разрешает работу и выделение средств: work authorization and release, фаза II. Сбор фактических затрат, анализ и отчётность идут затем.

text:
Scenario: For a data-center project, BCWS is $450, BCWP is $400 and ACWP is $500 (in thousands).
Question: What is the cost variance, and what does it indicate?
options: +50; the project is on budget.
-100; the work cost more than budgeted.
+100; the work cost less than budgeted.
-100; the project is ahead of schedule.
-50; the project is behind schedule.
explanation: CV = BCWP − ACWP = 400 − 500 = −100 тысяч. Выполненная работа обошлась дороже бюджета на 100 тысяч. Разность с BCWS относится к расписанию, поэтому вывод «ahead of schedule» не описывает CV.

text:
Scenario: A cloud-migration project shows BCWP = 400 and ACWP = 500 (thousand dollars).
Question: What is the CPI, and how should it be interpreted?
options: 1.25; work is faster than planned.
0.8; work is costing more than planned.
0.8; work is slower than planned.
1.0; cost performance is perfect.
1.25; work is costing less than planned.
explanation: CPI = BCWP / ACWP = 400 / 500 = 0,8. На каждый потраченный доллар получено 0,8 доллара бюджетной ценности: перерасход. Скорость относительно расписания измеряет SPI, а 1,25 получается при перевёрнутой дроби.

text:
Scenario: An HR-system project has a budget at completion of $1,000 thousand and a current CPI of 0.8.
Question: What is the estimate at completion if this efficiency continues?
options: $1,000 thousand.
$800 thousand.
$1,200 thousand.
$1,250 thousand.
$1,080 thousand.
explanation: При сохранении эффективности EAC = BAC / CPI = 1000 / 0,8 = 1250 тысяч. Умножение на CPI ошибочно уменьшило бы итоговую стоимость при перерасходе.

text:
Scenario: Two weeks into a new digitization team, members argue about the approach and two senior developers openly compete to lead technical decisions.
Question: Which stage of group development is the team in?
options: Norming.
Adjourning.
Storming.
Performing.
Forming.
explanation: Споры о подходе и конкуренция за лидерство — storming. Forming — знакомство и неопределённость; norming — согласование правил; performing — продуктивная работа; adjourning — завершение.

text:
Scenario: A procurement specialist at a ministry is expected to finish a tender report and, on the same afternoon, to sit on an interview panel in another building. Doing one makes the other impossible.
Question: What is this situation called?
options: Role conflict.
Punctuated equilibrium.
Storming.
Group cohesiveness.
Groupthink.
explanation: Две несовместимые обязанности в одно время — role conflict. Это конфликт требований к роли, а не обязательно стадия развития группы или groupthink.

text:
Scenario: At an IT integrator in Almaty, management rates its engineers' technical skills very highly, yet most client projects finish late and over budget.
Question: What does this situation most likely indicate?
options: An ideal structure needing no change.
A market-wide fall in IT demand.
A shortage of technical certification.
Budgets that were set too generously.
A structural problem in managing projects.
explanation: Сильные технические навыки при регулярных срывах сроков и бюджета указывают на возможную проблему организации проектной работы. Это не доказательство нехватки сертификатов или падения рыночного спроса.

text:
Scenario: After a failed data migration at a bank, the project manager and the head of the infrastructure department each insist that the other caused the failure.
Question: If trust continues to grow, what should happen next?
options: Both managers readily admit responsibility.
Both managers deny that any problem exists.
The general manager replaces one of them.
Both escalate the issue to the customer.
Both begin to formally anticipate problems.
explanation: Последовательность из Lecture 5: отрицание → взаимные обвинения → признание ответственности → совместное решение → предвидение проблем. Сейчас стадия обвинений, поэтому следующий шаг — признать свою ответственность, а не сразу перейти к профилактике.

text:
Scenario: The finance department of a state-owned utility can see at a glance what each department spends and keep it within agreed limits.
Question: Which advantage of the traditional structure does this reflect?
options: One person responsible for each project.
Easier budgeting and cost control.
Higher motivation and innovation.
Fast response to customer needs.
A single customer focal point.
explanation: Функциональные подразделения дают понятные границы бюджетов и контроля расходов. Единый ответственный за весь проект и customer focal point, напротив, часто отсутствуют в классической структуре.

text:
Scenario: A client of a software firm in Astana keeps asking who is in charge of her project; each department head says it is responsible only for its own part.
Question: Which weakness of the traditional structure does this show?
options: Excessive project authority.
Too many bosses per employee.
Too few specialists to share.
Weak technical control.
No customer focal point.
explanation: Клиент не находит единую точку ответственности за проект — no customer focal point. Это типичный недостаток функциональной структуры, где каждый начальник отвечает лишь за свой участок.

text:
Scenario: Before creating any project positions, a company coordinates work between units through rules, planning processes, hierarchical referral and direct contact.
Question: What are these coordination methods called?
options: Integrating mechanisms.
Matrix role definitions.
Projectized authority lines.
Stages in the growth of trust.
Liaison department duties.
explanation: Rules, planning processes, hierarchical referral и direct contact — integrating mechanisms. Они координируют работу ещё до введения специальных проектных ролей и не означают создание матрицы.

text:
Scenario: In a defense contractor's projectized division, the program manager assigns all work and also conducts the merit reviews of team members.
Question: Which advantage of this structure does this illustrate?
options: Strong continuity in each discipline.
Better use of scarce specialists.
Lower cost through shared personnel.
Easier staff sharing between projects.
Full line authority over the project.
explanation: В projectized структуре PM имеет полную линейную власть: распределяет работу и оценивает людей. Экономное совместное использование редких специалистов, наоборот, не является её сильной стороной.

text:
Scenario: A fintech company in Astana has complex products with short life cycles as its primary output.
Question: Which organizational form is most worth considering?
options: A pure functional organization.
Departmental project leaders.
Liaison departments only.
A matrix organization.
Integrating mechanisms only.
explanation: Сложные продукты с коротким жизненным циклом требуют межфункциональной интеграции и гибкого распределения экспертов: стоит рассмотреть matrix. Это рекомендация под условия, а не утверждение, что матрица идеальна всегда.

text:
Scenario: An akimat is building a standard two-storey school from a design that has already been used for dozens of schools. Every construction step can be specified before work starts.
Question: Which type of process best fits this project?
options: An experimental process with frequent pivots.
An empirical process refined in each cycle.
An iterative process driven by user feedback.
An incremental process with emerging scope.
A defined process with steps set in advance.
explanation: Повторяемая школа по проверенному проекту с заранее известными шагами подходит defined process. Empirical/iterative подход особенно нужен там, где решение и требования приходится выяснять через опыт.

text:
Scenario: An agile team at a state agency has a fixed budget of 100 million tenge and a fixed six-month deadline. Halfway through, it is clear that not every requested feature will fit.
Question: Following the agile triangle, what should be adjusted?
options: The scope delivered within the fixed cost and time.
The quality, so that scope, cost and time stay fixed.
The deadline, so that full scope fits the budget.
The budget, so that full scope meets the deadline.
Both budget and deadline, while scope stays frozen.
explanation: В учебной agile triangle при фиксированных времени и стоимости варьируют объём: сначала доставляют наиболее ценное. Снижать качество ради всех функций или автоматически увеличивать оба ограничения — не требуемый подход.

text:
Scenario: A sponsor asks how the e-procurement project is going. The project manager reports that 80% of planned tasks are complete, but nothing can yet be demonstrated to users.
Question: Which agile principle shows the weakness of this progress report?
options: Business people and developers work together daily.
Working software is the main measure of progress.
The team reflects at regular intervals to improve.
Requirements changes are welcome even late on.
Simplicity maximizes the amount of work not done.
explanation: 80% задач без демонстрируемого результата не показывают ценность. В Agile основной показатель прогресса — работающий продукт, а не число закрытых задач или объём отчётов.

text:
Scenario: Before writing the code that calculates property tax, developers on an XP team first write automated checks that the code must pass.
Question: Which XP practice is the team using?
options: Refactoring.
Pair programming.
Customer tests.
Test-driven development.
Collective code ownership.
explanation: Автоматическую проверку пишут до рабочего кода — test-driven development. Refactoring улучшает структуру существующего кода, pair programming — работа парой; customer tests не являются здесь главным отличительным признаком.

text:
Scenario: Developers at a bank in Almaty are each assigned to three projects at once and lose time every time they move from one to another.
Question: Which Lean waste does this describe?
options: Motion.
Extra processes.
Task switching.
Partially done work.
Defects.
explanation: Постоянный переход между тремя проектами создаёт task switching: теряется контекст. Motion — передача/перемещение работы, partially done work — незавершённый запас, defects — ошибки.

text:
Scenario: A project leader at an Astana startup lets the developers choose the technical steps and tools, trusting their expertise rather than dictating the approach.
Question: Which Lean core concept does this reflect?
options: Optimize the whole.
Defer decisions.
Deliver fast.
Amplify learning.
Empower the team.
explanation: Разработчикам доверяют выбирать технический способ работы — empower the team. Здесь главный сигнал — самостоятельность команды, а не скорость поставки или откладывание решения.

text:
Scenario: During an iteration, a deputy director keeps pulling developers into unplanned meetings. The agile leader asks him to route requests through her instead.
Question: Which servant leader duty is she performing?
options: Carrying food and water.
Re-communicating the project vision.
Practicing transparency.
Shielding the team from interruptions.
Recognizing conflict as a positive step.
explanation: Лидер становится точкой входа для внешних запросов и защищает команду от незапланированных отвлечений. Carrying food and water — обеспечение ресурсами, а не фильтрация встреч.

text:
Scenario: A digital team at the Shymkent akimat decides which features to build next only after observing how citizens actually used the previous release of its service portal, rather than relying on a long upfront forecast.
Question: Which foundation of Scrum does this behavior reflect most directly?
options: Critical path analysis.
Waterfall phase gating.
Empiricism.
Lean thinking.
Predictive planning.
explanation: Решения принимаются по наблюдениям за использованием предыдущего релиза: empiricism. Lean thinking фокусируется на сокращении потерь, predictive planning — на предварительном прогнозе.

text:
Scenario: An IT manager at a bank proposes creating a testing sub-team inside the Scrum Team, with its own lead who reports to a senior developer.
Question: Which response is consistent with Scrum?
options: Accept it, since testers need a separate lead to stay focused.
Accept it, since cross-functional teams need specialized sub-units.
Accept it, if the Scrum Master approves the reporting line.
Reject it, since a Scrum Team has no sub-teams or hierarchies.
Reject it, since testing should be done by the Product Owner.
explanation: Внутри Scrum Team нет подкоманд и иерархий. Разные профессиональные навыки допустимы, но отдельная подчинённая тестовая команда противоречит этому устройству; PO не обязан лично выполнять тестирование.

text:
Scenario: A ministry assigns a steering committee of five deputy heads to act jointly as the Product Owner for a new licensing system.
Question: What is the main problem with this arrangement from a Scrum perspective?
options: The Product Owner must be a member of the Developers.
The Product Owner must be one person, not a committee.
Deputy heads lack the technical skills to size items.
A committee cannot attend the Daily Scrum every day.
The committee should include the Scrum Master as chair.
explanation: Product Owner — один человек с единой accountability, хотя он представляет интересы многих людей. Проблема комитета не в посещении Daily или навыках оценки, а в размывании ответственности.

text:
Scenario: The Scrum Master of a team at a telecom company announces: "I will decide who takes which task each morning so that you work efficiently."
Question: What is the main issue with this approach?
options: The Scrum Master should coach self-management, not assign work.
Task assignment is the Product Owner's job, not the Scrum Master's.
The Scrum Master should assign tasks only during Sprint Planning.
This is acceptable while the Developers are new to Scrum.
Task assignment should be done by the most senior Developer.
explanation: Scrum Master обучает self-management и помогает команде стать эффективнее. Developers сами решают, кто, что и как делает; передача раздачи задач PO или старшему разработчику не исправляет принципиальную проблему.

text:
Scenario: A team in Almaty proposes six-week Sprints because its features are large.
Question: What does Scrum say about this proposal?
options: Six weeks is allowed if stakeholders agree.
The Product Owner picks a new length each Sprint.
Sprints must be exactly two weeks long.
Sprint length may vary with feature size.
Sprints must be fixed at one month or less.
explanation: Sprint имеет фиксированную длительность не более месяца. Две недели — распространённый выбор, но не обязательное правило; крупные features нужно дробить, а не растягивать Sprint до шести недель.

text:
Scenario: The Daily Scrum at a telecom company regularly takes 45 minutes and consists of status reports to the department head.
Question: Which change best aligns it with Scrum?
options: Keep 45 minutes but limit it to three questions.
Cut it to 30 minutes and email status to managers.
Keep it to 15 minutes, focused on the Sprint Goal.
Move it to once a week to save working time.
Let the department head chair it for discipline.
explanation: Daily — 15 минут для Developers: проверить продвижение к Sprint Goal и адаптировать план. Это не 45-минутный отчёт начальнику; обязательные три вопроса не определяют современный Scrum.

text:
Scenario: At the end of a Sprint, the team and stakeholders from the Ministry of Health try the new features, discuss upcoming regulatory changes and agree to reorder the Product Backlog.
Question: Which Scrum event is taking place?
options: Backlog refinement.
Sprint Retrospective.
Sprint Planning.
Sprint Review.
Daily Scrum.
explanation: Команда и stakeholders исследуют результат и обсуждают изменения будущего продукта — Sprint Review. Retrospective посвящена улучшению способов работы команды, а Planning — следующему Sprint.

text:
Scenario: A team building an e-government portal for registering small businesses has no direct contact with entrepreneurs. The analyst describes 'Aigerim, 34, owner of a bakery in Shymkent', with her goals, skill level and a typical working day.
Question: What is the main purpose of creating this description?
options: To define the acceptance tests for the registration form.
To record the legal rules the registration portal must comply with.
To empathize with users and align the portal with their needs.
To estimate the development effort for each portal feature.
To replace later usability testing with real entrepreneurs.
explanation: Реалистичная персона помогает понять пользователя и согласовать продукт с его потребностями. Она не является acceptance test, оценкой трудозатрат или заменой проверки с реальными предпринимателями.

text:
Scenario: An analyst prepared one-page persona summaries for a clinic appointment app. After a month of interviews with patients, the team wants a richer picture of each persona.
Question: What is the most appropriate next step?
options: Keep the short versions, since long ones suit only waterfall projects.
Average the interview data into one generic persona.
Convert each persona directly into an acceptance test.
Replace the personas with a plain list of system actors.
Expand the personas into the long template using the new research.
explanation: Появились новые интервью и нужна глубина: расширь short persona до long template. Не нужно усреднять разных пользователей в одного или превращать персону в критерий приёмки.

text:
Scenario: To save time, a team designing a city bus app creates one persona that combines traits common to students, pensioners, tourists and commuters.
Question: What risk does this create?
options: A generic persona that tries to suit everyone at once.
A delay because long templates take months to complete.
Requirements that reflect only one department's opinion.
A persona too narrow to write any user stories from.
Too many personas that quickly inflate the product backlog.
explanation: Одна персона для студентов, пенсионеров, туристов и пассажиров теряет различимые цели и поведение. Риск — слишком общий образ «для всех», а не слишком узкая персона или слишком много персон.

text:
Scenario: A backlog item for a tax portal reads: 'As a taxpayer, I need to download my income certificate.'
Question: Which component of the common user story format is missing?
options: The effort estimate for the story.
The user role or persona (WHO).
The action or feature needed (WHAT).
The benefit or value to the user (WHY).
The acceptance criteria that confirm the story.
explanation: WHO уже есть — taxpayer; WHAT — download income certificate. Не хватает WHY: so that …, то есть пользы. Оценка и acceptance criteria могут добавляться отдельно, но не являются пропущенной частью этой формулы.

text:
Scenario: For the story 'As a borrower, I need to see my monthly loan payment so that I can plan my budget', the product owner adds: shows the amount in tenge; updates after each payment; visible on the home screen.
Question: What role do these added statements play?
options: They fix the order of stories in the next release.
They define the story's boundaries for verification.
They describe the borrower persona's motivations and traits.
They replace the conversation between team and users.
They give the team's effort estimate for the story.
explanation: Валюта, обновление после оплаты и расположение задают проверяемые границы конкретной истории — acceptance criteria. Это не оценка трудоёмкости и не замена разговору с пользователем.

text:
Scenario: A ministry replaced 200-page specifications with user stories and now releases a small piece of its licensing service every two weeks.
Question: What is the main benefit of this change?
options: Stories remove the need to refine the backlog.
Stories make long-term estimates exact.
Small testable slices give fast delivery and feedback.
Stories let the team skip stakeholder talks.
Stories hold complete specs, so fewer questions arise.
explanation: Малые проверяемые части дают быстрые поставки и обратную связь. User stories не отменяют refinement и общение, не гарантируют точность долгосрочных оценок и не содержат всю спецификацию.

text:
Scenario: The backlog of an e-government portal has grown to 900 user stories, many of them outdated or duplicated, and planning meetings take hours.
Question: Which action best addresses this limitation of user stories?
options: Add more developers to finish all 900 stories.
Stop writing acceptance criteria to save time.
Refine and reprioritize the backlog regularly.
Convert every story into a detailed specification.
Freeze the backlog until the end of the project.
explanation: Большой backlog с дублями и устаревшими историями нужно регулярно уточнять, очищать и переупорядочивать. Заморозка сохраняет мусор; новые разработчики не решают проблему актуальности требований.

text: A logical grouping of contract tasks that have not yet been identified or authorized is held in which budget?
options: The distributed budget.
The management reserve.
The undistributed budget.
The unallocated budget.
The performance budget.
explanation: В Lecture 4 unallocated budget — логическая группа ещё не идентифицированных/не авторизованных контрактных задач. Undistributed относится к изменениям контракта, которые не успели включить в performance budget. Эти два термина легко перепутать.

text: Why is the earned value measurement system described as an early warning system?
options: It compares final cost with the bid after closure.
It shows deviations from plan while still small.
It sets the management reserve for each phase.
It predicts the exact final cost with certainty.
It replaces periodic re-estimation of the cost.
explanation: EVMS — early warning system: обнаруживает отклонения, пока они малы. Он не гарантирует точный прогноз и не заменяет регулярное переоценивание оставшихся затрат.

text: Which list gives the reasons why people form groups?
options: Productivity, flexibility, diversity and quality.
Structure, status, roles, norms and leadership.
Needs, proximity, attraction, goals and economics.
Forming, storming, norming, performing, adjourning.
Cost, schedule, technical performance and risk.
explanation: Причины объединения людей: needs, proximity, attraction, goals, economics. В D перечислены стадии развития, в B — характеристики группы; это другой вопрос.

text: Which term means being answerable for completing a specific assignment satisfactorily?
options: Accountability.
Responsibility.
Coordination.
Integration.
Authority.
explanation: Being answerable за удовлетворительное выполнение назначения — accountability. Responsibility означает обязанность выполнить работу, authority — право принимать решения.

text: Through whose eyes is a matrix described as strong or weak?
options: The line manager’s.
The customer’s.
The functional workers’.
The general manager’s.
The project manager’s.
explanation: Strong/weak оценивают с позиции project manager: насколько сильны его полномочия относительно functional manager. Это не оценка с позиции заказчика или просто размера компании.

text: In a matrix, what is the project manager accountable for?
options: The overall success of the project.
The technical excellence of each discipline.
Setting the company’s overhead rates.
Merit reviews of all functional staff.
Resolving conflicts between all projects.
explanation: PM отвечает за общий успех проекта. Техническое качество каждой дисциплины остаётся у функционального руководства; PM не получает автоматически право оценивать всех функциональных сотрудников.

text: Which Agile Manifesto value best reflects the view that skilled team members matter more than methods?
options: Processes and tools over individuals and interactions.
Individuals and interactions over processes and tools.
Customer collaboration over contract negotiation.
Responding to change over following a plan.
Working software over comprehensive documentation.
explanation: Здесь нужна пара individuals and interactions over processes and tools. A переворачивает приоритет; C–E — другие верные пары Manifesto, но не ответ на данный смысл вопроса.

text: What does the Kanban principle “make process policies explicit” ask a team to do?
options: Own and improve the process together through experiments.
Track the flow of work to measure the effect of changes.
Write down how work is done so all can discuss it.
Restrict the number of items in progress at once.
Show every work item on a shared, visible board.
explanation: Explicit policies — явно описать, как проходит работа, чтобы правила можно было обсуждать и улучшать. D — limit WIP, E — visualize workflow, B — manage flow; это соседние принципы Kanban.

text: Which statement is one of the eight DSDM principles?
options: Limit work in progress.
Defer decisions.
Expect uncertainty.
Sustainable pace.
Demonstrate control.
explanation: Demonstrate control входит в восемь принципов DSDM. Limit WIP связан с Kanban, defer decisions — с Lean, sustainable pace — с XP/Agile; не смешивай списки методов.

text: According to the Scrum Guide, what do the Scrum values give direction to?
options: The length of each Sprint.
The content of the Definition of Done.
The selection of team tools.
The order of Product Backlog items.
The team’s work, actions and behavior.
explanation: Scrum values направляют работу, поступки и поведение команды. Они не назначают длительность Sprint, инструменты или конкретный порядок элементов backlog.

text: What is the maximum timebox for Sprint Planning in a one-month Sprint?
options: Eight hours.
Three hours.
Two hours.
Four hours.
Fifteen minutes.
explanation: Для месячного Sprint Planning ограничен восемью часами. Четыре часа — Review, три — Retrospective, 15 минут — Daily; для коротких Sprint события обычно короче.

text: According to the Scrum Guide, who is responsible for sizing Product Backlog items?
options: The organization’s senior management.
The Scrum Master, who coaches the team.
The key stakeholders, who fund the product.
The Developers who will do the work.
The Product Owner, who orders the items.
explanation: Размер работы оценивают Developers, которые её выполнят. PO помогает понять ценность и компромиссы, но не назначает оценку; Scrum Master поддерживает процесс.

text: Which persona element states what makes one persona unique compared with another persona?
options: Name and image.
Differentiators.
Needs.
Motivations.
Short template.
explanation: Differentiators показывают, чем одна персона отличается от другой. Motivations — почему взаимодействует с продуктом, needs — конкретные потребности, name/image — узнаваемость образа.

text: Under INVEST, what makes a user story Testable?
options: It can be delivered apart from other features.
The team can negotiate how to deliver it.
A stakeholder can validate it objectively.
The team can estimate it from past experience.
It shows the value it brings to the customer.
explanation: Testable означает объективную проверку результата заинтересованной стороной. Independent — возможность отдельной поставки, Negotiable — обсуждаемость, Estimable — оценимость, Valuable — ценность.

text: What style is recommended for the title on a user story card?
options: A number from the product backlog.
A short acceptance criterion.
A noun naming the system module.
An active-verb goal phrase.
The name of the main persona.
explanation: Название карточки истории лучше формулировать как цель с активным глаголом, например «Book appointment». Номер backlog, название модуля и имя персоны не выражают цель действия.

text:
Scenario: At an IT startup in Astana, hours worked and money spent are entered into the project records only at the end of each quarter, often two months after the work was done.
Question: Which requirement of effective cost and schedule control is weakest here?
options: Thorough planning of the work to be done.
Timely accounting of progress and costs.
Disciplined authorization of spending.
Clear communication of the task scope.
Good estimating of labor and costs.
explanation: Расходы и прогресс учитывают с большой задержкой — нарушено timely accounting. Даже подробный план бесполезен для своевременной коррекции, если фактические данные приходят через месяцы.

text:
Scenario: Each month the project manager of a digital-ID project presents status, variances and forecasts to the client ministry and to the company’s executive board.
Question: Which phase of the operating cycle does this represent?
options: Cost analysis.
Customer and management reporting.
Cost data collection and reporting.
The planning cycle.
Work authorization and release.
explanation: PM сообщает клиенту и высшему руководству статус, отклонения и прогнозы — customer and management reporting, фаза V. Это не первичная регистрация затрат и не выдача разрешения на работу.

text:
Scenario: A school-digitization project reports, in million tenge: BCWS = 80, BCWP = 80, ACWP = 70.
Question: What can be concluded from CV and SV?
options: Over budget by 10 and exactly on schedule.
Over budget by 10 and ahead of schedule by 10.
On budget and ahead of schedule by 10.
Under budget by 10 and behind schedule by 10.
Under budget by 10 and exactly on schedule.
explanation: CV = 80 − 70 = +10 млн тенге: экономия. SV = 80 − 80 = 0: точно по графику. Не меняй местами фактические расходы ACWP и плановую ценность BCWS.

text:
Scenario: A fintech startup’s project has CPI = 1.1 and SPI = 0.75.
Question: What should be the main focus of corrective action?
options: Improving the productivity of the work force.
Reducing the burn rate of the budget.
Re-baselining the budget at completion.
Improving the timeliness of physical progress.
Releasing the management reserve.
explanation: CPI = 1,1 говорит о хорошей эффективности затрат, SPI = 0,75 — об отставании физического прогресса от плана. Значит, внимание нужно расписанию, а не сокращению расходов или резерву.

text:
Scenario: A project was originally planned to last 12 months, and its SPI is now 0.8.
Question: What is the new estimated project length?
options: 12.8 months.
10 months.
14 months.
9.6 months.
15 months.
explanation: По упрощённой формуле лекции новая длительность = исходная / SPI = 12 / 0,8 = 15 месяцев. Это прогноз при сохранении эффективности, а не точная дата окончания проекта.

text:
Scenario: The team that launched an akimat’s open-data portal has delivered all tasks. Members hold a final meeting, and some express sadness about losing daily contact.
Question: Which stage of group development is this?
options: Norming.
Performing.
Storming.
Forming.
Adjourning.
explanation: Работа завершена, команда прощается — adjourning. Performing описывает продуктивную работу до завершения, storming — конфликт, forming — начало.

text:
Scenario: At an akimat, management, the IT team and the analyst herself each have a different picture of what the ‘business analyst’ position should involve.
Question: How is this situation best explained?
options: One role can be perceived in up to three ways.
The team has fallen into groupthink.
The team has reached the adjourning stage.
The analyst is going through the storming stage.
The analyst has joined an informal interest group.
explanation: У роли есть ожидаемая, воспринимаемая и исполняемая стороны: разные участники могут видеть её по-разному. Само различие представлений не доказывает groupthink или стадию storming.

text:
Scenario: An akimat’s digital projects are delivered on time and to specification, but the groups and individuals involved are not satisfied with what they achieved.
Question: What does this pattern most likely suggest?
options: No change is needed because targets were met.
The akimat has found its ideal permanent structure.
The projects were scoped far too conservatively.
Met targets can still hide a structural mismatch.
Staff satisfaction has nothing to do with structure.
explanation: Сроки и спецификации могут быть соблюдены, но неудовлетворённость участников всё равно сигнализирует о структурном несоответствии. Это повод рассмотреть организацию работы, а не автоматически объявить её идеальной.

text:
Scenario: At a bank in Almaty, a project manager and a functional manager have stopped blaming each other, and each has openly admitted their part in a delayed release.
Question: What is the next stage in the growth of their trust?
options: Denying that the problem exists at all.
Meeting face-to-face to solve the problem.
Blaming each other once the problem surfaces.
Anticipating problems before they occur.
Escalating the problem to the general manager.
explanation: После признания ответственности следующий этап доверия — личная совместная работа над проблемой. Anticipating problems идёт позднее; отрицание и обвинения — предыдущие этапы.

text:
Scenario: A regional bank is debating whether to keep its classical functional structure.
Question: Which statement is an advantage of that structure?
options: Projects rarely fall behind their schedules.
One individual is responsible for the total project.
Ideas are strongly oriented toward the ongoing projects.
Vertical communication channels are well established.
Decisions are balanced across all functional groups.
explanation: У функциональной структуры хорошо установлены вертикальные каналы общения. Сквозная ответственность за проект и сбалансированные межфункциональные решения при этом не гарантируются.

text:
Scenario: In a functional engineering firm, every dispute about a joint design is settled in favor of the largest and most powerful department.
Question: Which weakness of the traditional structure is this?
options: There is no technical control over the design.
Personnel cannot be reused across projects.
Decisions favor the strongest units.
There are too many project managers involved.
Communication channels are poorly established.
explanation: Если в споре всегда побеждает самый мощный отдел, решения смещены в пользу сильнейших подразделений. Это не отсутствие технического контроля или вертикальных каналов.

text:
Scenario: An engineering division has a liaison department that handles engineering changes between its units. A conflict now arises between the engineering and manufacturing divisions.
Question: How is this conflict most likely resolved?
options: The engineering head decides alone.
The customer is asked to arbitrate.
It is referred to upper management.
The task force votes on a solution.
The liaison department resolves it alone.
explanation: Liaison department работает в пределах своего division и не обладает властью разрешать конфликт между divisions. Такой конфликт передают выше — upper management.

Question: Which XP role does this person hold?
options: Tester.
Customer.
Coach.
Sponsor.
Programmer.
explanation: В XP Customer представляет бизнес, определяет требования и приоритеты и подтверждает нужный результат. Tester проверяет, Coach помогает применять XP, Programmer реализует.

text:
Scenario: Without being asked, a team adds an animated 3D dashboard to an akimat’s reporting system. The akimat never uses it.
Question: Which Lean waste does this represent?
options: Defects.
Partially done work.
Motion.
Extra features.
Extra processes.
explanation: Команда построила ненужный пользователю 3D dashboard — extra features. Даже исправная законченная функция является потерей, если её не просили и не используют.

text:
Scenario: Instead of inspecting the finished system at the end, a team reviews and tests every piece of work as soon as it is produced, at each stage of development.
Question: Which Lean core concept does this reflect?
options: Defer decisions.
Optimize the whole.
Eliminate waste.
Build quality in.
Deliver fast.
explanation: Проверки встроены в каждый этап, а не оставлены на конец — build quality in. Это точнее, чем общее eliminate waste или deliver fast.

text:
Scenario: Two senior developers on a ministry project openly disagree about the system architecture and debate it in a team meeting.
Question: How should an agile leader view this conflict?
options: As a positive step in team development.
As acceptable only if a manager chairs it.
As a reason to impose a final decision.
As a sign the team should be split up.
As a matter to settle outside the team.
explanation: Открытое обсуждение технических разногласий может быть полезным шагом развития команды. Не следует автоматически подавлять спор, навязывать решение или разделять людей; речь о конструктивном обсуждении, не о личных нападках.

text:
Scenario: Halfway through a Sprint, the Developers of a fintech startup discover that a payment API they are integrating behaves differently than they assumed.
Question: When does Scrum expect the team to adjust its plan and work?
options: At the end of the release, when all data is available.
As soon as possible, to minimize further deviation.
Only after the Product Owner cancels the Sprint.
At the Sprint Review, after stakeholders give feedback.
At the next Sprint Retrospective, after discussion.
explanation: Обнаружив новое поведение API, команда адаптирует план как можно раньше. Не нужно ждать Review, Retrospective или отмены Sprint, если можно сохранить его цель.

Scenario: For a one-month Sprint, a team schedules a four-hour Sprint Review and a four-hour Sprint Retrospective.
Question: Which statement is correct?
options: The Review exceeds its two-hour maximum.
The Retrospective exceeds its three-hour maximum.
Both are within their timeboxes for a one-month Sprint.
The Review exceeds its three-hour maximum.
Both events exceed their two-hour maximum.
explanation: Для месячного Sprint Review ≤4 часов, Retrospective ≤3 часов. Значит, четырёхчасовой Review допустим, а четырёхчасовая Retrospective превышает timebox на час.

text:
Scenario: An IT outsourcing company in Astana builds a mobile app for the tax authority, but its developers are not allowed to meet taxpayers directly.
Question: Which technique best helps the team understand value from the taxpayer’s point of view?
options: Personas.
Story decomposition.
Product roadmap.
Regression testing.
Velocity tracking.
explanation: Persona помогает представить цели и контекст налогоплательщика, когда прямой контакт затруднён. Roadmap описывает развитие продукта, velocity — объём работы, regression testing — проверку старого поведения.

text:
Scenario: An analyst for a regional akimat’s social-benefits portal has official statistics on the age, district and income of benefit applicants.
Question: How should she best use this data?
options: As input used only for the project cost estimate.
As the product vision statement for the portal.
As the acceptance criteria for each user story.
As a replacement for personas, since statistics are more exact.
As a starting point for a representative pool of personas.
explanation: Статистика — исходные данные для набора репрезентативных персон. Она сама по себе не описывает мотивацию конкретных сегментов, не заменяет personas и не задаёт acceptance criteria.

text:
Scenario: A team designing an online pension calculator plans to use personas as the only source of user insight for the whole project.
Question: Which is the strongest argument against this plan?
options: Personas are not a substitute for real user input.
Personas cannot be ranked by the benefit they get.
Personas can only be used by the product owner.
Personas cannot include images or names of users.
Personas must always start with the long template.
explanation: Персоны — модель пользователей; они не заменяют реальные интервью, наблюдения и проверку решения. Их можно использовать всей командой, делать короткими и дополнять изображениями.

text:
Scenario: A junior developer at a fintech startup believes that only the product owner may write user stories and that every backlog item must be a user story.
Question: Which statement is correct?
options: Only the product owner writes stories, and every item must be a story.
Several roles may write stories; not every item must be one.
Testers write stories after the feature has already been built.
Only customers write stories, and other items stay off the backlog.
Only developers write stories, since they estimate and deliver them.
explanation: Истории могут писать разные роли, а Product Backlog может содержать и другие виды элементов. Accountability PO за backlog не означает, что только он должен лично написать каждую историю.
