Which three common varieties can a matrix structure take?
options: Strong, weak, or balanced.
Departmental, divisional, or liaison.
Pure, functional, or projectized.
Simple, complex, or hybrid.
Line, staff, or line-staff.
explanation: Три разновидности матрицы — weak, balanced, strong. Они различаются распределением полномочий между PM и functional manager, а не просто сложностью продукта.

text: Why is project engineering separated from project management in a matrix?
options: So all conflicts go to the general manager.
So costs can be shared among several projects.
So a liaison department can handle design changes.
To keep technical direction with engineering.
So the project manager can conduct merit reviews.
explanation: Project engineering отделяют, чтобы техническое руководство оставалось за инженерной функцией. PM интегрирует проект целиком; такое разделение не даёт ему автоматически merit reviews всех специалистов.

text: Under the Agile Manifesto, why should effort go into responding to change rather than following a plan?
options: Plans have no value once development begins.
Changes are rare in knowledge worker projects.
Detailed plans slow down contract negotiation.
Initial plans were made when least was known.
Plans must be fixed before scope can vary.
explanation: Первоначальный план составляют при минимуме знаний, затем опыт позволяет его уточнять. Responding to change не означает, что планы бесполезны или их нельзя создавать.

text: In Kanban, what is the main purpose of limiting work in progress?
options: To identify issues and minimize waste.
To keep every team member fully busy.
To fix the scope before each iteration.
To replace the need for a task board.
To make the team deliver every two weeks.
explanation: Ограничение WIP делает проблемы потока заметнее и уменьшает потери от слишком большого числа незавершённых задач. Цель не в максимальной занятости каждого человека и не в обязательных двухнедельных итерациях.

text: Which practice is part of the set of good practices recommended by Feature-Driven Development?
options: Individual code ownership.
Test-driven development.
Collective code ownership.
Pair programming.
Limiting work in progress.
explanation: В FDD есть individual code ownership. Collective ownership, pair programming и TDD обычно отличают XP; limit WIP — Kanban. Здесь важно узнавать практику конкретного метода.

text: Which list correctly names the five Scrum values?
options: Commitment, focus, transparency, respect and empiricism.
Commitment, openness, adaptation, trust and simplicity.
Commitment, focus, openness, respect and courage.
Transparency, inspection, adaptation, respect and courage.
Courage, focus, inspection, respect and self-management.
explanation: Пять ценностей: commitment, focus, openness, respect, courage. Transparency, inspection, adaptation — pillars; empiricism — основа Scrum, а не дополнительная ценность.

text: According to the Scrum Guide, which elements together make up the Sprint Backlog?
options: The selected items, the team's capacity and a burn-down chart.
The Product Goal, the Sprint Goal and the release schedule.
The Sprint Goal, the whole Product Backlog and the last Increment.
The Product Goal, the selected items and the Definition of Done.
The Sprint Goal, the selected items and the plan to deliver them.
explanation: Sprint Backlog = Sprint Goal (WHY) + выбранные Product Backlog items (WHAT) + план доставки (HOW). Весь Product Backlog и Product Goal не заменяют эту тройку.

text: What must a Scrum Team do when its organization has a standard Definition of Done?
options: Replace it with its own definition.
Follow it as a minimum.
Ask the Product Owner to approve a lower version.
Use it only when several teams share a product.
Follow it only for items that are released.
explanation: Организационный Definition of Done обязателен как минимум. Команда может добавить строгость, но не заменить его более слабой версией; правило относится ко всем элементам Increment.

text: What does the short persona template offer compared with the long template?
options: A set of acceptance criteria for each story.
An in-depth story of the user's typical day.
A full list of the user's wants and wishes.
A ranked list of features for the release.
A one-page quick view of key information.
explanation: Short persona — быстрый одностраничный обзор ключевой информации. Long template даёт более глубокий контекст, например день из жизни; список критериев истории — другой артефакт.

text: Which INVEST criterion is met when a story explains why the customer will benefit from it?
options: Testable.
Valuable.
Independent.
Estimable.
Negotiable.
explanation: Если история объясняет пользу клиенту, выполняется Valuable. Testable — проверяемость, Independent — независимость, Estimable — оценимость, Negotiable — обсуждаемость.

text: What does the Card in the 3Cs mainly contain?
options: The effort estimate and the deadline.
Notes from every team discussion.
A brief story and an optional title.
The acceptance tests for the feature.
The full specification of the feature.
explanation: Card содержит краткую историю и необязательное название. Детали выясняются в Conversation, а проверка принятия относится к Confirmation; карточка не должна притворяться полной спецификацией.

text:
Scenario: A ministry project has a detailed plan, sound estimates, an approved budget and up-to-date cost records. However, actual progress and spending are compared with the baseline only once, at project completion.
Question: What is the most appropriate improvement to the control system?
options: Prepare a more detailed work breakdown structure.
Compare actuals with plan frequently.
Re-estimate the original budget with a new method.
Communicate the project scope to the team again.
Ask the vendor to record costs more often.
explanation: Фактические данные уже есть, но их сравнивают с планом только после завершения. Нужны frequent comparisons, а не ещё один подробный WBS или более частая регистрация самих затрат.

text:
Scenario: A new PMO head in Almaty claims that once the project plan is approved, planning has no further connection to how costs are authorized, collected, analyzed and reported.
Question: Which statement best corrects this view?
options: Planning is repeated only when the customer requests it.
Cost control is a complete system independent of planning.
Planning is the last phase and follows customer reporting.
The operating cycle fully replaces planning after approval.
Planning and operations form one closed system.
explanation: Planning и четыре операционные фазы образуют замкнутую систему MCCS. План задаёт базу для разрешения работ, сбора данных, анализа и отчётности, а обратная связь уточняет дальнейшие действия.

text:
Scenario: A software team measures in hours: BCWS = 1,200, BCWP = 1,000, ACWP = 1,100.
Question: Which statement about the variances is correct?
explanation: CV = 1000 − 1100 = −100 часов; SV = 1000 − 1200 = −200 часов. Используются бюджетные трудозатраты выполненной работы; обе отрицательные разницы показывают неблагоприятное отклонение.

text:
Scenario: A telecom project in Karaganda reports BCWS = 750, BCWP = 600 and ACWP = 500.
Question: Which pair of indices is correct?
options: CPI = 1.2 and SPI = 1.25.
CPI = 0.8 and SPI = 1.2.
CPI = 0.8 and SPI = 1.25.
CPI = 1.25 and SPI = 0.8.
CPI = 1.2 and SPI = 0.8.
explanation: CPI = 600 / 500 = 1,2; SPI = 600 / 750 = 0,8. По стоимости есть эффективность, по графику — отставание. Во всех числителях стоит earned value BCWP.

text:
Scenario: A bank's CRM project has BAC = 800, BCWP = 400 and ACWP = 500 (thousand dollars).
Question: If current cost efficiency continues, what is the variance at completion?
explanation: CPI = 400 / 500 = 0,8. EAC = 800 / 0,8 = 1000. VAC = BAC − EAC = 800 − 1000 = −200 тысяч: ожидается перерасход на 200 тысяч, не экономия.

text:
Scenario: A task force with an eight-week deadline spent the first four weeks discussing options with little progress. At the midpoint, realizing time was running out, it changed course and worked intensively to finish.
Question: Which model best explains this pattern?
options: The groupthink model.
The closed-system cost model.
The punctuated equilibrium model.
The storming stage of development.
The five-stage maturity model.
explanation: Долгое малоподвижное начало и резкий пересмотр работы в середине срока — punctuated equilibrium. Это не просто storming: в условии ключевой признак — midpoint transition.

text:
Scenario: A director notices that several team leaders face simultaneous demands where meeting one demand rules out the others, and she wants to know why management should care.
Question: What is the main organizational consequence of such role conflict?
options: Faster movement to the performing stage.
A shift from formal to informal groups.
Slower movement from forming to storming.
Higher overhead rates in every department.
Ineffective performance by people and groups.
explanation: Несовместимые требования к ролям мешают эффективно работать отдельным людям и группам. Они не гарантируют рост накладных расходов или какую-либо конкретную стадию развития.

text:
Scenario: Staff at a telecom company in Astana are highly committed to project work, yet how well specifications are met varies greatly between projects. The CEO asks a consultant to design "the one ideal structure that will suit us forever".
Question: Which response reflects the soundest organizational thinking?
options: Review it, accepting no structure is ideal.
Adopt a pure functional structure, ideal for all firms.
Keep the current structure, since commitment is high.
Loosen the specifications so the variation disappears.
Adopt a matrix, since it is ideal for every company.
explanation: Универсальной идеальной структуры навсегда нет. Нужно оценить соответствие структуре работы и среде; высокая вовлечённость не отменяет проблему нестабильного результата.

text:
Scenario: A new PMO director at a ministry wants project and functional managers to anticipate problems jointly from next week, although they currently deny that problems exist.
Question: What is the most realistic expectation?
options: A policy memo lets managers skip straight to anticipation.
Denial is actually the final, most mature stage of trust.
Anticipation normally comes before admitting responsibility.
Several intermediate stages of trust must come first.
Trust develops only when the PM has full line authority.
explanation: Нельзя приказом перескочить из отрицания сразу к совместному предвидению. Между ними идут обвинения, признание ответственности и совместное решение; доверие развивается последовательно.

text:
Scenario: A manufacturer in Karaganda produces standard products in large volumes within established specifications and runs very few one-off projects.
Question: Why is the traditional structure a reasonable fit here?
options: It speeds up decisions that cross departments.
It suits mass production within set specifications.
It gives each project manager full line authority.
It lets staff be dedicated to a single project.
It provides a strong focal point for each customer.
explanation: Классическая функциональная структура подходит стабильному массовому производству по заданным спецификациям. Её достоинство здесь — соответствие повторяемой работе, а не полная власть PM над отдельным проектом.

text:
Scenario: A ministry asks why its functional structure produces "committee solutions" for projects and why nobody can be pinpointed when a project fails.
Question: What is the best explanation?
options: Specialists are grouped by discipline to share work.
Vertical communication channels are too weak.
The project manager holds too much line authority.
No one holds formal authority over the total project.
Each employee reports to more than one functional manager.
explanation: В функциональной структуре может не быть человека с формальной властью над всем проектом. Поэтому ответственность дробится между отделами и получаются committee solutions.

text:
Scenario: A company finds that project coordinators placed inside functional departments keep putting functional work ahead of their projects.
Question: Which principle should guide the next step in organizing project work?
options: Give project control to people loyal to the project.
Keep project leaders within each functional department.
Rely only on better rules and planning procedures.
Let liaison staff coordinate within one division.
Let functional managers run project merit reviews.
explanation: Если функциональные задачи постоянно вытесняют проект, контроль проекта следует дать людям, ориентированным на его успех. Сохранение той же лояльности отделу или одни новые процедуры не устраняют конфликт приоритетов.

text:
Scenario: A holding company is considering a projectized structure for one of its subsidiaries.
Question: Under which condition does such a structure give stable work and minimal conflict?
options: Rare and very short projects.
Wide sharing of specialists.
Cost minimization as top priority.
Priorities set by functional heads.
A continuous flow of projects.
explanation: Постоянный поток проектов обеспечивает занятость выделенных проектных команд и уменьшает конфликт за дальнейшую работу. Редкие короткие проекты делают чистую projectized структуру менее устойчивой.

text:
Scenario: A consultant compares several companies in Kazakhstan that are considering a matrix structure.
Question: For which company would a matrix be most practical?
options: A firm with little need for specialist skills.
A firm in a rapidly changing market.
A firm mass-producing one stable product.
A firm with one long project at a time.
A firm with stable, predictable demand.
explanation: Матрица особенно уместна в быстро меняющейся среде, где нужна межфункциональная гибкость. Стабильное массовое производство может обходиться функциональной структурой; универсального лучшего варианта нет.

text:
Scenario: A bank in Almaty planned its new mobile app the way it plans branch construction, fixing every step in advance. Three months later, many requirements had changed and the plan was obsolete.
Question: What is the most likely root cause of the problem?
options: A defined process was used for uncertain work.
The developers lacked a detailed enough upfront plan.
The team used too many short iterations and increments.
The sponsor approved the project budget too early.
The bank should have hired more construction experts.
explanation: Неопределённую разработку приложения планировали как полностью предсказуемое строительство. Ошибка — defined process для uncertain work; ещё более подробный первоначальный план не убирает неопределённость.

text:
Scenario: An analyst at a fintech company in Astana first studied and internalized agile principles, then began applying agile practices in her own work.
Question: What is the next step in her path to organizational change?
options: Practice agile techniques herself.
Fix scope and let cost and time vary.
Learn agile principles individually.
Encourage others to become agile.
Write a defined process for all teams.
explanation: Путь в лекции: понять принципы самому → применять практики → помогать другим стать agile → изменения организации. Первые два этапа уже сделаны, следующий — encourage others.

text:
Scenario: A team split between Astana and Shymkent relies on long email threads to clarify requirements, and misunderstandings keep causing rework.
Question: Which agile principle points to the best improvement?
options: Working software measures progress best.
Simplicity is essential to every project.
Technical excellence enhances agility.
Face-to-face talk conveys information best.
Late requirement changes should be welcome.
explanation: Для сложного уточнения требований прямой разговор быстрее устраняет неоднозначность, чем длинные письма. Для распределённой команды смысл — организовать живое обсуждение, например видеовстречу, а не отменить полезную письменную фиксацию.

text:
Scenario: An XP team merges everyone's code only once a month and then spends several days fixing code that no longer compiles or works together.
Question: Which XP practice would best address this problem?
options: Continuous integration.
Sustainable pace.
Metaphor.
Planning games.
Collective code ownership.
explanation: Редкие слияния приводят к поздним конфликтам интеграции. Continuous integration — частое объединение и проверка изменений; collective ownership отвечает на вопрос владения кодом, а не частоты интеграции.

text:
Scenario: Analysts in Astana hand designs to developers in Almaty, who hand code to testers in Shymkent. Each handoff takes extra effort to explain and transfer.
Question: Which Lean waste is most evident?
options: Motion.
Extra features.
Task switching.
Extra processes.
Defects.
explanation: Передача работы между аналитиками, разработчиками и тестерами в разных городах — motion в классификации Lean из курса. Task switching — когда один человек меняет задачи, extra features — ненужные функции.

text:
Scenario: Early in a project, a team runs weekly sessions where citizens try prototypes of a new portal and give feedback that the team uses immediately.
Question: Which Lean core concept is the team mainly applying?
options: Empower the team.
Defer decisions.
Amplify learning.
Optimize the whole.
Build quality in.
explanation: Прототипы, регулярная обратная связь и немедленное применение выводов усиливают обучение — amplify learning. Главный сигнал не в полномочиях команды и не в отсрочке решения.

text:
Scenario: Team members at a bank hide failed prototypes from their leader because past mistakes were openly criticized. As a result, few new ideas are tried.
Question: Which leadership task should the leader focus on first?
options: Re-communicating the project vision often.
Providing more licences and equipment.
Adding approval steps for new prototypes.
Making experimentation safe.
Shielding the team from outside interruptions.
explanation: Страх наказания за неудачный прототип подавляет обучение. Лидер должен сделать эксперименты безопасными: неудача становится источником выводов, а не поводом для публичного унижения.

text:
Scenario: A ministry IT department removes several approval documents that nobody reads and keeps only the activities that directly help deliver the product.
Question: Which idea underlying Scrum does this change reflect?
options: Lean thinking.
Empiricism.
Transparency.
Cross-functionality.
Self-management.
explanation: Убирают бесполезные документы и сохраняют действия, дающие ценность — lean thinking. Empiricism означает решения по наблюдениям, transparency — видимость состояния; в вопросе акцент на устранении потерь.

text:
Scenario: A state agency staffs a team in which all UX design and database work must be requested from other departments, causing week-long waits every Sprint.
Question: Which Scrum Team characteristic is missing?
options: A single Product Owner.
Self-management.
Cross-functionality.
Small team size.
Openness.
explanation: Если необходимые UX и database навыки всегда снаружи и команда неделями ждёт, ей не хватает cross-functionality. Self-management отвечает за право организовать работу, а не за наличие всех нужных компетенций.

text:
Scenario: In a state company, department heads regularly overrule the Product Owner's ordering of the Product Backlog, and the Developers receive conflicting priorities.
Question: What does Scrum say is needed for the Product Owner to succeed?
options: Department heads should jointly own the Product Backlog with the Product Owner.
The entire organization must respect the Product Owner's decisions.
Priorities should be fixed at the start and not changed.
The Scrum Master should approve every change to item order.
Developers should order the items they find most urgent.
explanation: Организация должна уважать решения Product Owner о порядке backlog. Stakeholders могут убеждать PO, но не создавать параллельную систему приоритетов и коллективного владения его accountability.

text:
Scenario: A newly appointed Scrum Master in an akimat IT department approves vacations, sets individual KPIs for each Developer and reports their personal performance to management.
Question: Which description of the Scrum Master shows that this behavior is wrong?
options: The team member who decides how work is done.
A true leader who serves the Scrum Team.
The person who orders the Product Backlog.
The line manager accountable for each Developer.
A coordinator who reports progress to management.
explanation: Scrum Master — лидер, служащий команде, а не её линейный начальник. Отпуска, индивидуальные KPI и персональные отчёты как основная роль здесь не отражают его Scrum accountability.

text:
Scenario: Mid-Sprint, the Developers of a university admissions portal realize one selected item is much larger than expected, although the Sprint Goal is still achievable with less scope.
Question: What does Scrum allow them to do?
options: Clarify and renegotiate scope with the Product Owner.
Change the Sprint Goal without involving anyone else.
Cancel the Sprint, since the forecast was wrong.
Ask the Scrum Master to extend the Sprint end date.
Lower the quality bar so all items can be finished.
explanation: Scope можно уточнить и пересогласовать с PO по мере обучения, сохраняя Sprint Goal и качество. Не нужно автоматически отменять или продлевать Sprint; менять цель в одностороннем порядке тоже нельзя.

text:
Scenario: The Daily Scrum of a regional akimat team is held at different times and places each day, and participants mostly report how many hours they worked.
Question: What is the main purpose of the event that they are missing?
options: Re-order the Product Backlog with the Product Owner.
Report hours worked to the Scrum Master for tracking.
Demonstrate finished work to stakeholders for feedback.
Review the team's processes and Definition of Done.
Inspect Sprint Goal progress and adapt the plan.
explanation: Daily помогает Developers проверить движение к Sprint Goal и адаптировать план. Отчёт по часам, демонстрация stakeholders и ретроспективный анализ процессов — не его основная цель.

text:
Scenario: In a Sprint Retrospective, a team at a mobile operator finds that failed deployments were caused by manual steps and decides to automate them.
Question: What can the team do with this improvement?
options: Wait for the Product Owner at the next Review.
Implement it in the current Sprint after the Retrospective.
Ask stakeholders to approve it at the next Review.
Record it only; changes are allowed after the release.
Add it to the Sprint Backlog for the next Sprint.
explanation: Полезное улучшение можно включить в Sprint Backlog следующего Sprint. Retrospective завершает текущий Sprint, поэтому вариант «после Retrospective в текущем Sprint» вводит в заблуждение; разрешение stakeholders не требуется.

text:
Scenario: A product owner of a city parking app says: 'Personas are just a nicer name for user roles such as Admin or Driver.'
Question: Which statement best corrects this view?
options: Personas are job titles used to assign system access rights.
Personas are real customers who are quoted by name in specs.
Personas are groups of features ranked by development cost.
Personas are fictional archetypes of typical users.
Personas are team roles defined within the Scrum framework.
explanation: Persona — вымышленный архетип типичного пользователя с целями и контекстом. Это не просто роль доступа Admin/Driver, не конкретный реальный клиент и не роль Scrum Team.

text:
Scenario: A startup in Astana needs a quick view of its key users for a planning meeting tomorrow morning, and there is no time for further research.
Question: Which persona format best fits this need?
options: A context diagram showing all external systems.
A full demographic report from the statistics agency.
A one-page short template with key facts.
A long template with an in-depth day-in-the-life story.
A detailed use case model listing all actors.
explanation: Для быстрого обзора нужен short template с ключевыми фактами на одной странице. Long template нужен для глубины; нехватка исследований не означает, что можно выдавать предположения за проверенные факты.

text:
Scenario: An analyst writes a single persona called 'Average citizen' who is any age, lives in any region, speaks all languages and is equally at ease with mobile and desktop.
Question: What is the main weakness of this persona?
options: It is too short to count as a persona at all.
It has too many differentiators to be ranked properly.
It is too generic to be distinct or realistic.
It was written before the product roadmap existed.
It focuses on wants instead of on motivations.
explanation: «Любой возраст, любой регион, одинаковые навыки» стирает различия и делает образ нереалистичным. Полезная персона должна описывать узнаваемую группу с конкретным контекстом.

text:
Scenario: An analyst wants to rewrite the story 'As a citizen, I need to book a slot at a public service center so that I do not wait in a queue' in the alternative format.
Question: Which version is the correct equivalent?
options: 'In order to book a slot, as a citizen, I need to avoid a queue.'
'In order to avoid a queue, as a citizen, I need to book a slot.'
'Given a free slot, when a citizen books it, the queue is avoided.'
'Citizen books a slot, system confirms, queue time goes down.'
'As a service center, I need slots booked so that queues shrink.'
explanation: Альтернативный порядок: In order to WHY, as WHO, I need WHAT. Здесь WHY — avoid a queue, WHO — citizen, WHAT — book a slot. Given/When — формат сценария проверки, а не та же история.

text:
Scenario: An akimat's appointment-booking story was accepted, but citizens later found they could book visits on public holidays. Nobody had stated what the feature should and should not allow.
Question: What was most likely missing?
options: A product roadmap for the next year.
A more detailed title on the story card.
A larger team to deliver the story.
A longer persona template for citizens.
Clear acceptance criteria for the story.
explanation: Не указали разрешённое и запрещённое поведение для праздничных дней — отсутствовали ясные acceptance criteria. Большая команда, roadmap или более длинная персона не задают эти правила автоматически.

text:
Scenario: After several joint story-writing sessions, developers and the operations staff of a bank understand each other's work much better and feel more committed to the product.
Question: Which strength of user stories does this illustrate?
options: Stories guarantee that all estimates will be accurate.
Stories cut the number of team meetings down to zero.
Joint work on stories builds shared understanding.
Stories allow the team to skip backlog refinement.
Stories move responsibility for value to the developers.
explanation: Совместное написание историй создаёт shared understanding и вовлечённость. Оно не отменяет refinement и встречи, не гарантирует точные оценки и не переносит accountability за ценность с PO на Developers.

text:
Scenario: Decomposing the epic 'Online onboarding for new bank clients' produced 40 child stories, some outdated and a few contradicting each other.
Question: What should the analyst do?
options: Ask developers to choose which stories to implement.
Merge all child stories back into a single large one.
Turn the child stories into personas for each group.
Organize the child stories to keep them current.
Stop decomposition and deliver the epic in one iteration.
explanation: Декомпозиция требует поддержки связности дочерних историй: удалять устаревшее, разрешать противоречия, сохранять актуальность. Обратное слияние в большой epic или превращение историй в personas проблему не решает.

text:
Scenario: In a projectized company, two small projects each need a GIS analyst for only half of the working week.
Question: Under a pure projectized structure, what is the most likely outcome?
options: A liaison department supplies the analyst.
Neither project gets an analyst at all.
The analyst is shared to reduce total costs.
Each project keeps its own full-time analyst.
A functional manager lends the analyst part time.
explanation: В чистой projectized структуре люди закреплены за проектами: возможны два недозагруженных штатных аналитика. Совместное использование специалистов экономнее, но это уже не характерный результат pure projectized модели из лекции.

text:
Scenario: A telecom operator moving to a matrix structure asks HR what to prepare.
Question: Which set of measures does matrix implementation require?
options: One boss per employee and vertical channels.
Rules, procedures and hierarchical referral.
Training, open communication and role definitions.
Separate budgets for each functional unit.
Dedicated staff, line authority and merit reviews.
explanation: Матрица требует обучения, открытой коммуникации и чёткого определения ролей, иначе двойное подчинение вызывает конфликты. Один начальник и только вертикальные каналы описывают функциональную модель.

text:
Scenario: A digital health project in Almaty involves doctors, data scientists and software engineers who analyze problems and design the new clinical system together.
Question: Why are these people considered knowledge workers?
options: They work mainly with physical materials and tools.
They hold university degrees in technical fields.
They apply expertise in analysis and development.
They follow fixed steps that others define in advance.
They hold formal management positions.
explanation: Knowledge workers применяют знания для анализа и разработки решений. Диплом или должность сами по себе не определяют тип работы; главное — её интеллектуальное содержание.

text:
Scenario: A ministry IT department introduced task boards and short iterations, but managers still dictate every technical decision and punish failed experiments.
Question: Which statement best describes this department?
options: It is doing agile without being agile.
It is being agile but not yet doing agile.
It is using a defined process correctly.
It has fixed scope and let cost and time vary.
It has reached full organizational agility.
explanation: Доски и итерации — doing agile, но подавление самостоятельности и наказание экспериментов противоречат being agile. Практики без ценностей не дают полноценной организационной гибкости.

text:
Scenario: Two weeks before release, the ministry asks for a change to the citizen registration form. The team accepts it, since it gives citizens a better service.
Question: Which agile principle is the team following?
options: Keep a sustainable pace for all sponsors.
Reflect regularly and adjust behavior.
Deliver working software every few months.
Trust motivated individuals to do the job.
Welcome changing requirements, even late.
explanation: Команда принимает позднее изменение, потому что оно улучшает сервис: welcome changing requirements, even late. Остальные принципы тоже полезны, но не описывают главный сигнал условия.

text:
Scenario: At an IT company in Almaty, all production code is developed while a colleague reviews the logic continuously during implementation.
Question: Which XP practice does this describe?
options: Whole team.
Small releases.
Code standards.
Collective code ownership.
Pair programming.
explanation: Совместная разработка с непрерывной проверкой вторым человеком — pair programming. Collective ownership означает, что команда может менять общий код; само по себе оно не требует работы вдвоём.
transcriptionNote: Фото размыто: перед заучиванием дословной формулировки сверь оригинал. Смысл вопроса и варианты читаются.

text:
Scenario: A ministry has twenty finished specifications that have waited months for development, and code that has not been retested for weeks.
Question: Which Lean waste is most evident?
options: Partially done work.
Task switching.
Extra processes.
Motion.
Extra features.
explanation: Спецификации ждут реализации, код ждёт проверки — это запас незавершённой работы, partially done work. Даже готовый документ не означает готовую пользовательскую ценность; task switching — другая потеря.
transcriptionNote: Фото размыто: перед заучиванием дословной формулировки сверь оригинал. Смысл вопроса и варианты читаются.

text:
Scenario: A team postpones choosing a database vendor until it understands the data volumes better, while still doing enough early planning.
Question: Which Lean core concept is the team applying?
options: Empower the team.
Build quality in.
Eliminate waste.
Deliver fast.
Defer decisions.
explanation: Выбор откладывают до получения достаточной информации, продолжая разумное планирование: defer decisions. Это не отказ принимать решение вообще, а сохранение вариантов до ответственного момента.

text:
Scenario: An agile leader at an Astana startup makes sure the team has the laptops, software licences and system access it needs to stay productive.
Question: Which servant leader duty does this illustrate?
options: Shielding the team from interruptions.
Carrying food and water.
Recognizing conflict as positive.
Communicating the project vision.
Practicing transparency.
explanation: Carrying food and water — метафора обеспечения команды необходимыми ресурсами: техникой, доступами, лицензиями. Защита от прерываний — отдельная обязанность servant leader.

text:
Scenario: At a bank in Almaty, the Scrum Team's task board is updated only once a month, so managers who inspect progress often decide on the basis of outdated information.
Question: How does Scrum theory describe inspection carried out under these conditions?
options: Monthly updates are sufficient because Sprints last one month.
Inspection is unnecessary if the team adapts frequently.
Transparency matters only for the Product Backlog.
Low transparency affects the team but not decision quality.
Inspection without transparency is misleading and wasteful.
explanation: Проверка устаревшей картины работы вводит в заблуждение: inspection нуждается в transparency. Частая адаптация без достоверной информации не исправляет фундаментальную проблему.

text:
Scenario: Before an item is marked finished, a Developer notices that a teammate skipped a required code review and raises it directly with him so it is fixed.
Question: Which accountability of the Developers does this illustrate?
options: Causing the removal of impediments.
Establishing Scrum in the organization.
Maximizing the value of the product.
Ordering the Product Backlog items.
Holding each other accountable.
explanation: Developers поддерживают профессиональную ответственность друг друга, в том числе соблюдение Definition of Done. Создание Scrum в организации — Scrum Master, максимизация ценности и порядок backlog — PO.

text:
Scenario: A startup in Astana is discussing who should develop and explicitly communicate its long-term objective: "become the main mobile app for paying utility bills in Kazakhstan".
Question: Who is accountable for this?
options: The Developers.
The startup's investors.
The Product Owner.
The Scrum Master.
The whole organization by vote.
explanation: Долгосрочная цель продукта — Product Goal. За её разработку и явную коммуникацию accountable Product Owner; это не голосование всей организации и не личная задача Scrum Master.

text:
Scenario: A Scrum Master at a national railway company spends part of her time training managers in other departments and advising on how to roll out Scrum across the company.
Question: Which statement best describes this activity?
options: It replaces her accountability for team effectiveness.
It should be done only by an external consultant.
It is how the Scrum Master serves the organization.
It is a Product Owner duty that was wrongly delegated.
It is outside the Scrum Master's accountability entirely.
explanation: Обучать организацию и помогать внедрять Scrum — часть служения Scrum Master организации. Это дополняет, а не отменяет его accountability за эффективность команды.

text:
Scenario: During a Sprint, the government changes the regulation that the team's Sprint Goal was meant to implement, so the goal no longer makes sense.
Question: Who has the authority to cancel the Sprint?
options: Only the Product Owner.
The Developers by majority vote.
The head of the IT department.
Only the Scrum Master.
Any member of the Scrum Team.
explanation: Когда Sprint Goal устаревает, только Product Owner вправе отменить Sprint. Developers и stakeholders могут повлиять на решение, но не получают эту власть автоматически.

text:
Scenario: At 11 a.m., a Developer hits a serious blocker. A teammate says: "We can only change our plan at the Daily Scrum, so let's wait until tomorrow."
Question: Is the teammate right?
options: No; Developers may adapt their plan at any time.
No; plan changes require starting a new Sprint.
Yes; plan changes are made only at the Daily Scrum.
No; plan changes require the Scrum Master's approval.
Yes; plan changes are made only at Sprint Planning.
explanation: Daily — регулярная точка проверки, а не единственное разрешённое время менять план. Developers могут адаптироваться в течение дня, не ожидая разрешения Scrum Master или начала нового Sprint.

text:
Scenario: On an e-licensing project, the team asks who will mainly use the acceptance criteria to verify and validate that each delivered story meets the user need.
Question: Who primarily uses acceptance criteria for this purpose?
options: The Scrum Master, to track velocity.
External auditors, after the release.
The HR department, to rate the staff.
The developers alone, while coding.
The product owner and stakeholders.
explanation: PO и stakeholders используют acceptance criteria для проверки соответствия истории потребности. Developers тоже работают с критериями, но вариант D ошибочно ограничивает проверку только ими и только кодированием.

text:
Scenario: Clerks at a regional akimat, with no IT background, learned to write useful user stories during a short morning workshop.
Question: Which strength of user stories does this show?
options: They are tied to small, testable slices.
They build shared understanding of the domain.
They are simple enough to learn very quickly.
They invite conversation and decomposition.
They can be supplemented with analysis models.
explanation: Люди без IT-подготовки быстро научились писать истории — simple to learn quickly. Shared understanding и decomposition тоже достоинства, но главный факт условия — короткое обучение.

text:
Scenario: Developers who moved to an agile team from a waterfall project at a bank complain that they cannot start work without a detailed specification for each story.
Question: Which limitation of user stories does this reflect?
options: Stories cannot be estimated by experienced teams.
Stories fail to show the value to the customer.
Stories can be written only by the product owner.
Stories do not give full specs upfront.
Stories are too large to finish in one iteration.
explanation: История не даёт полной спецификации заранее: детали раскрывают в разговоре и критериях. Это ограничение требует сотрудничества, а не означает невозможность оценки или обязательный огромный размер истории.

text: Why do analysts give a persona a realistic name and a fictional image?
options: To show which market segment buys the most.
To give each persona a unique system ID.
To separate it clearly from other personas.
To make it relatable and build empathy.
To rank personas by their expected benefit.
explanation: Реалистичное имя и вымышленный образ помогают воспринимать персону как конкретного человека и развивать эмпатию (empathy). Это не статистика покупок, технический ID или рейтинг ценности. Отличия между персонами описывают differentiators; здесь спрашивается именно, зачем очеловечивать образ.

text: What does the Independent criterion in INVEST mean for a user story?
options: It can be delivered apart from other features.
Its delivery approach is open to team discussion.
It can be checked objectively by a stakeholder.
It is small enough to finish in one iteration.
Its effort can be estimated from past experience.
explanation: Independent — история по возможности самостоятельна: её можно реализовать и доставить без обязательного ожидания других функций. B описывает Negotiable, C — Testable, D — Small, E — Estimable. Отличай независимость от размера: маленькая история всё ещё может иметь сильные зависимости.

text: In the 3Cs, how is Confirmation most often expressed?
options: As a story title.
As acceptance criteria.
As a long persona template.
As an effort estimate.
As a product roadmap.
explanation: Confirmation фиксирует, как убедиться, что история реализована правильно: это acceptance criteria и проверяемые примеры/тесты. Card кратко напоминает о потребности, Conversation уточняет смысл, Confirmation проверяет договорённость. Заголовок, оценка усилий, persona и roadmap сами по себе не задают условия приёмки.

text:
Scenario: On an akimat road-monitoring project, several department heads bought equipment and hired contractors directly, without any sign-off from the project manager.
Question: Which requirement of an effective control system is being violated?
options: Periodic re-estimation of time and cost to complete.
Timely accounting of physical progress.
Clear communication of the scope of tasks.
Frequent comparison of actual progress to schedule.
Disciplined budgeting and authorization of spending.
explanation: Ключевой сигнал — расходы и договоры без согласования (without any sign-off). Нарушена дисциплина бюджета и разрешения на расходование средств: authorization of spending. Пересчёт прогноза (A), учёт прогресса (B), объяснение scope (C) и сравнение с графиком (D) решают другие проблемы контроля.

text:
Scenario: Every Friday the project office of a regional hospital IT project gathers timesheets, supplier invoices and purchase records and enters them into the cost system.
Question: Which phase of the operating cycle is being performed?
options: Reporting to customer and management.
The planning cycle.
Cost analysis.
Work authorization and release.
Cost data collection and reporting.
explanation: Сбор timesheets, invoices и purchase records с занесением в систему — cost data collection and reporting. Это получение и регистрация фактических затрат. Анализ (C) начинается при сравнении и интерпретации этих данных; разрешение работ (D) предшествует исполнению; отчёт заказчику и руководству (A) — отдельная фаза представления выводов.

text: In a matrix, who keeps the responsibility for technical excellence on the project?
options: The project coordinators.
The general manager.
The project manager.
The director of project management.
The functional departments.
explanation: В матрице функциональные подразделения отвечают за техническое качество и профессиональные стандарты. PM интегрирует работу и отвечает за общий результат проекта, но техническая экспертиза остаётся у функций.

text: What does the Agile Manifesto say about the items on the right side of its four values?
options: They have no value and should be removed from projects.
They matter only in large government projects.
They are valued equally with the items on the left.
They have value, but the left items are valued more.
They are valued more than the items on the left.
explanation: Agile не отменяет процессы, инструменты, документацию, контракты и планы. Они имеют ценность, но при выборе приоритет получают люди, работающий продукт, сотрудничество и реакция на изменения. Слово over означает приоритет, а не запрет.

text: Which Kanban principle restricts how many items the team handles at once, making bottlenecks [end of line cut off] see?
options: Limit WIP.
Improve collaboratively.
Manage flow.
Make process policies explicit.
Visualize the workflow.
explanation: Limit WIP ограничивает число задач в работе одновременно. Когда лимит достигнут, команда помогает завершить начатое и видит узкие места. Доска показывает работу, а управление потоком улучшает её прохождение; это связанные, но разные практики.
transcriptionNote: Правый край строки обрезан. Сохранён читаемый текст; все пять вариантов видны полностью.

text: Which method is centered on eight principles such as "focus on the business need" and "never [end of line cut off] quality"?
options: DSDM.
Crystal.
FDD.
XP.
Kanban.
explanation: Восемь принципов, включая Focus on the business need и Never compromise quality, относятся к DSDM. Crystal адаптируется к людям и контексту, FDD строится вокруг features, XP — инженерных практик, Kanban — потока работы.

text: Which Scrum value means keeping primary attention on the work of the Sprint to make the [end of line cut off] toward its goals?
options: Commitment.
Courage.
Transparency.
Respect.
Focus.
explanation: Focus — внимание к работе Sprint и его целям. Commitment означает приверженность целям и поддержку команды, Courage — смелость решать трудные проблемы, Respect — уважение. Transparency — столп эмпиризма, а не одна из пяти ценностей Scrum.

text: Which of the 3Cs reflects that a user story intentionally leaves out details so the team will discuss them?
options: Commitment.
Conversation.
Card.
Confirmation.
Collaboration.
explanation: Conversation — обсуждение деталей истории с командой и заинтересованными сторонами. Card оставляет короткую запись, которая запускает этот разговор, а Confirmation задаёт проверку результата. Commitment и Collaboration не являются названиями элементов модели 3Cs.

Фото размыто или обрезано: нельзя надёжно восстановить весь вопрос и все A–E. Ответ не угадываем.

text:
Scenario: A cost engineer on a smart-city project in Shymkent studies why the actual spending on sensors exceeds the budget and identifies the causes of the variance.
Question: This work belongs to which phase of the operating cycle?
options: Cost data collection and reporting.
Work authorization and release.
Reporting to customer and management.
Cost analysis.
The planning cycle.
explanation: Поиск причин превышения бюджета — Cost analysis. Здесь затраты уже собраны и сравниваются с планом. Сбор первичных счетов относится к collection, разрешение начать работы — к authorization, а сообщение результатов руководству — к reporting.
transcriptionNote: Текст прочитан с общего фото разворота с увеличением; пунктуация нормализована.

text:
Scenario: A ministry project has CPI = 0.8 and SPI = 1.0.
Question: Where should the project manager place the main emphasis?
options: On the productivity of the work.
On increasing the budget at completion.
On raising funds from the undistributed budget.
On the timeliness of physical progress.
On shortening the remaining schedule.
explanation: CPI = EV / AC = 0,8: на единицу затрат создаётся только 0,8 единицы бюджетной ценности, поэтому надо улучшать эффективность затрат и продуктивность. SPI = 1,0 означает соответствие графику; ускорение само по себе не решит перерасход.

text:
Scenario: An HR specialist at a bank in Almaty writes down the pattern of behavior attached to the position of 'release manager', regardless of who fills it.
Question: Which concept is being described?
options: A role set.
A norm of the group.
Group cohesiveness.
A role.
A status hierarchy.
explanation: Role — ожидаемый образ поведения, связанный с позицией, независимо от конкретного человека. Role set описывает связанные ролевые отношения, norm — правило группы, cohesiveness — сплочённость, status hierarchy — различия в положении участников.

text:
Scenario: On a ministry's e-government project, the testing group and the development group constantly blame each other for missed specifications and delivery dates.
Question: Which conclusion is most appropriate for senior management?
options: Delivery dates should be removed from the project plan.
The testing group should be disbanded and outsourced.
The organization may not be designed for project work.
Only the development group's leader should be replaced.
The testing group lacks the needed technical skills.
explanation: Постоянное перекладывание ответственности между функциями может показывать, что организационная структура плохо поддерживает проекты. Нужны проверка взаимодействия и ответственности. Из взаимных обвинений нельзя сразу вывести нехватку навыков тестировщиков или необходимость увольнения одного руководителя.

text:
Scenario: A project manager sees a growing integration problem, but both she and the head of the QA department tell every status meeting that "everything is fine".
Question: At which stage of trust are the two managers?
options: Blaming each other for the problem.
Admitting responsibility for it.
Denying that a problem exists.
Anticipating problems together.
Working it out face-to-face.
explanation: Обе стороны отрицают проблему: внешне говорят, что всё хорошо, хотя трудность уже есть. Это Denying. Обвинение предполагает признание проблемы с переносом вины, а совместное предупреждение и личное решение относятся к более зрелому взаимодействию.

text:
Scenario: The HR department of a ministry values that every employee has one and only one person to report to.
Question: Which advantage of the traditional structure does this provide?
options: Good control over personnel.
Quick response to customers.
Strong horizontal communication.
Clear project accountability.
Simple cross-unit coordination.
explanation: Одна линия подчинения облегчает управление персоналом: ясно, кто назначает задачи и оценивает сотрудника. Быстрая реакция на клиента, горизонтальные связи и межфункциональная координация не следуют автоматически из традиционной функциональной структуры.

text:
Scenario: At a traditionally organized bank, a decision on a new loan system needs sign-off from four departments, adding several weeks to the schedule.
Question: Which disadvantage does this illustrate?
options: Specialists unable to share their knowledge.
Difficult budgeting and cost control.
Employees having more than one supervisor.
Complex coordination and slow approvals.
Weak technical control over the work.
explanation: Решение проходит четыре подразделения и задерживается на недели: это сложная координация и медленные согласования. Несколько согласующих подразделений не означают, что у каждого сотрудника несколько непосредственных руководителей.

text:
Scenario: Each functional unit of a bank places a representative on a group that jointly solves project problems; work is on time, but in conflicts members side with their home departments.
Question: Which arrangement is this, and what is its key weakness?
options: A strong matrix in which the PM dominates daily work.
A liaison department whose authority ends at the division.
A traditional structure with no customer focal point.
A pure project team with very high overhead costs.
A task force whose members stay loyal to their units.
explanation: Представители разных функций образуют task force — временную группу для совместного решения задач. Их основная лояльность остаётся у своих подразделений. Это может мешать общему решению, даже если работа пока выполняется вовремя.

text:
Scenario: A projectized team at an IT company keeps a database specialist on the project for months after her tasks are finished.
Question: Why does this typically happen in such structures?
options: The PM fears not getting her back later.
Contracts forbid moving staff between projects.
Merit reviews require full project tenure.
She reports to a line manager in another unit.
Functional managers refuse to take her back.
explanation: В проектной структуре PM может удерживать редкого специалиста из опасения, что потом его не удастся вернуть. Так возникает неэффективное использование ресурсов. В условии нет запрета контракта, требований аттестации или отказа функционального менеджера.

text:
Scenario: A company adopts a matrix structure but continues to reward staff only for meeting their functional department's goals.
Question: Which implementation requirement is missing?
options: A single reporting line.
A larger marketing budget.
Hierarchical referral.
Compatible reward systems.
Fully dedicated project staff.
explanation: Матрице нужна совместимая система вознаграждений: цели функций и проекта не должны конфликтовать. Если премируют только функциональные результаты, сотрудники будут выбирать их в ущерб проекту. Единственный начальник и полностью выделенный штат не определяют матрицу.

text:
Scenario: A ministry's portfolio office is deciding which of its upcoming projects should be run with agile [end of line cut off] methods.
Question: Which project characteristic most strongly favors an agile approach?
options: A fixed scope fully signed off by the customer.
Low uncertainty and a stable technology base.
Knowledge work in a fast, complex setting.
Repeatable work with well-known physical steps.
Predictable tasks that follow a known sequence.
explanation: Agile особенно полезен для сложной интеллектуальной работы с быстрыми изменениями и неопределённостью. Итерации дают обратную связь и возможность адаптироваться. Стабильные повторяемые операции легче описать заранее определённым процессом.
transcriptionNote: Правый край строки сценария обрезан. Пропуск отмечен; вопрос и все варианты полные.

text:
Scenario: A sponsor tells the project manager: "Every feature in the specification must be delivere[end of line cut off]. Estimate whatever time and money that takes."
Question: Which planning model does this instruction reflect?
options: The agile triangle, with scope allowed to vary.
The traditional triangle, with scope fixed.
An empirical model driven by experimentation.
The inverted triangle, with cost and time fixed.
A model where only cost and quality are fixed.
explanation: Спонсор фиксирует scope, а сроки и деньги предлагает оценить под него. Это традиционный треугольник. При инверсии обычно фиксируют время и стоимость, а объём адаптируют. Экспериментирование не является основным признаком этого условия.
transcriptionNote: Последнее слово первой строки обрезано на фото; это явно отмечено, варианты ответов полные.

text:
Scenario: A team reviews its backlog and drops six rarely used report features, delivering the same business value with much less effort.
Question: Which agile principle does this decision apply?
options: Early and continuous delivery of value.
Self-organizing teams creating designs.
Daily collaboration with business people.
Continuous attention to technical excellence.
Simplicity, maximizing the work not done.
explanation: Команда убирает ненужную работу и сохраняет ценность — это Simplicity, искусство максимизировать невыполняемую работу. Условие не о частоте релизов, ежедневном общении или качестве кода, хотя эти принципы тоже важны.

text:
Scenario: A developer restructures a tangled module to make it easier to read. Users see no change in behavior and no new functions are added.
Question: Which XP practice is being applied?
options: Simple design.
Test-driven development.
Metaphor.
Continuous integration.
Refactoring.
explanation: Refactoring меняет внутреннюю структуру существующего кода без изменения наблюдаемого поведения. TDD начинает с теста, continuous integration часто объединяет изменения, metaphor даёт общее представление, simple design поддерживает простое достаточное решение.

text:
Scenario: Every small change on an e-government project needs four signatures, and the team produces weekly reports that nobody reads.
Question: Which Lean waste does this represent?
options: Task switching.
Extra processes.
Extra features.
Defects.
Partially done work.
explanation: Лишние подписи и невостребованные отчёты — Extra processes: действия, которые не создают нужной ценности. Extra features — ненужные возможности продукта, defects — ошибки, task switching — переключения, partially done work — незавершённые запасы.

text:
Scenario: The development unit of a ministry doubled its own speed, but overall delivery to citizens slowed because testing and deployment could not keep up.
Question: Which Lean core concept was neglected?
options: Amplify learning.
Build quality in.
Optimize the whole.
Empower the team.
Defer decisions.
explanation: Optimize the whole требует улучшать весь поток до пользователя. Ускорение разработки не улучшает доставку, если растут очереди перед тестированием и релизом. Это локальная оптимизация, ухудшившая общий результат.

text:
Scenario: Two candidates for team leader describe their style. One focuses on tasks, control and speed; the other on people, purpose and empowerment.
Question: How are these two styles best classified?
options: Both describe servant leadership in agile teams.
The first is agile; the second is a defined process.
The first is management; the second is leadership.
Both describe traditional command and control.
The first is leadership; the second is management.
explanation: В сравнении из лекции management связан с задачами, контролем и эффективностью, leadership — с людьми, направлением и расширением их возможностей. Это различие акцентов: хороший руководитель может сочетать оба набора навыков.

text:
Scenario: At every Sprint Review, an e-government team in Astana identifies the same usability problems and records them in a report, but never changes the Product Backlog or its way of working.
Question: How does Scrum characterize this situation?
options: The team is applying empiricism correctly.
The team is applying lean thinking correctly.
Adaptation should wait until the product is released.
Inspection without adaptation is pointless.
Transparency without inspection is misleading.
explanation: Проблемы регулярно замечают, но не реагируют: inspection не приводит к adaptation. Эмпиризм требует использовать наблюдения для изменения действий. Запись в отчёте сама по себе не исправляет продукт и не заменяет адаптацию.

text:
Scenario: In a newly formed Scrum Team at a logistics company, the department head insists on assignin[end of line cut off] daily tasks to each Developer and deciding how they should be done.
Question: Which characteristic of a Scrum Team does this conflict with most directly?
options: Transparency.
Self-management.
Lean thinking.
Cross-functionality.
Timeboxing.
explanation: Self-management означает, что Scrum Team сама решает, кто, что, когда и как делает. Внешний начальник, назначающий каждому технический способ работы, нарушает это свойство. Cross-functionality касается наличия нужных компетенций, а не распределения приказов.
transcriptionNote: Окончание слова в первой строке обрезано; пропуск отмечен, все варианты читаются.

text:
Scenario: A deputy akim wants a new feature moved to the top of the work list and tells the Developers directly to add it.
Question: What is the appropriate way for him to get the Product Backlog changed?
options: Raise it at the Daily Scrum so Developers can vote.
Ask the Developers to add it to the current Sprint.
Ask the Scrum Master to reorder the Product Backlog.
Add it directly, since senior officials outrank the team.
Convince the Product Owner to change the backlog.
explanation: За управление и порядок Product Backlog отвечает Product Owner. Заинтересованная сторона должна убедить PO изменить приоритет. Должность чиновника не даёт права обходить эту ответственность; Daily Scrum не является голосованием о продуктовых приоритетах.

text:
Scenario: In a team with one-month Sprints, the Sprint Review regularly runs for six hours, and the Daily Scrum often exceeds half an hour.
Question: What should the Scrum Master ensure?
options: That timeboxes are extended when stakeholders need it.
That events take place and stay within the timebox.
That the Product Owner decides how long events last.
That long events are split into separate presentations.
That timeboxes are applied only to the Daily Scrum.
explanation: Scrum Master помогает обеспечить проведение полезных событий в рамках timebox. Для месячного Sprint Review ограничен четырьмя часами, Daily Scrum — 15 минутами. Нельзя постоянно растягивать их или считать ограничение обязанностью только PO.

text:
Scenario: Midway through a Sprint, a deputy minister asks the team to swap half of its items for unrela[end of line cut off] urgent work. The change would make the still-valid Sprint Goal unreachable.
Question: What is the most appropriate response?
options: Extend the Sprint by two weeks to fit in the new work.
Swap the items, since senior officials can change Sprint scope.
Place the request in the Product Backlog for a later Sprint.
Accept the work and reduce testing to fit everything in.
Let the Scrum Master cancel the Sprint and start a new one.
explanation: Во время Sprint нельзя вносить изменения, ставящие Sprint Goal под угрозу. Цель ещё актуальна, поэтому запрос стоит обсудить с PO для будущего Sprint. Продлевать Sprint, снижать качество или отдавать Scrum Master право отмены — неверно.
transcriptionNote: Конец слова в первой строке обрезан; пропуск отмечен. Условие о Sprint Goal и все варианты полные.

text:
Scenario: Developers at a bank want to drop the familiar "three questions" and instead walk the board item by item, focusing on the Sprint Goal. The Scrum Master is unsure.
Question: How does Scrum view this change?
options: It is allowed only for Sprints shorter than two weeks.
It is allowed; Developers choose the structure and techniques.
It is not allowed; the board is reviewed only at the Sprint Review.
It is allowed only if the Product Owner approves it.
It is not allowed; the three questions are mandatory.
explanation: Developers выбирают структуру и технику Daily Scrum, если событие помогает проверить прогресс к Sprint Goal и составить рабочий план. Три вопроса не обязательны. Согласование с PO и длительность Sprint не являются условиями такого выбора.

text:
Scenario: A team at an IT park company turns its Sprint Review into a 30-minute slideshow with no discussion, and stakeholders leave without giving input.
Question: What is the best advice for this team?
options: Replace it with a written report sent after the Sprint.
Move the discussion of next steps to the Retrospective.
Keep it short, since the review is mainly a formal demo.
Skip stakeholders and present only to the Product Owner.
Make it a working session to decide what to do next.
explanation: Sprint Review — рабочая встреча Scrum Team и заинтересованных сторон: они изучают результат и изменения среды, обсуждают дальнейшие шаги. Слайд-шоу без обратной связи не выполняет эту цель. Retrospective улучшает способы работы команды и не заменяет Review.

text:
Scenario: A university portal team has described five personas: applicant, first-year student, lecturer, dean's office clerk and parent. The budget covers features for only some of them in the first release.
Question: What should the team do with these personas?
options: Drop any persona that has no record in the student database.
Treat all five as equally important by default.
Let developers vote for the persona they find most interesting.
Merge them into one average user to simplify the design.
Rank them to find those who gain the most benefit.
explanation: При ограниченном бюджете персоны помогают определить приоритеты по ожидаемой пользе. Нельзя автоматически считать их равными или выбирать по личному интересу разработчиков. Объединение в усреднённого пользователя скроет важные различия.

text:
Scenario: In workshops for a ministry's document-flow system, each department head insists the system should work exactly the way he or she personally works.
Question: Which benefit of personas helps the analyst deal with this situation?
options: Personas stop stakeholders projecting their own biases.
Personas remove the need for workshops with departments.
Personas give department heads final say on priorities.
Personas fix the scope so that no changes are allowed.
Personas replace the product owner in decision making.
explanation: Персоны возвращают обсуждение к потребностям целевых пользователей и уменьшают проецирование личных привычек участников. Они не отменяют встречи и исследования, не фиксируют scope навсегда и не подменяют Product Owner.

text:
Scenario: Personas for a university distance-learning portal were written in 2020, when most students studied from home. Today most classes are held on campus.
Question: What should the analyst do?
options: Review and update the personas.
Merge all the personas into a single average student.
Delete the personas and rely only on role descriptions.
Turn the old personas into acceptance criteria.
Keep the personas, since they are fictional anyway.
explanation: Контекст использования изменился, поэтому нужно проверить и обновить персоны на основе актуальных данных. Персона вымышленная, но должна правдоподобно отражать реальные нужды. Это не основание хранить устаревшие описания или заменять их одной средней ролью.

transcriptionNote: Условие и правильный вариант различимы, но текст варианта A размыт. Не включён, чтобы сохранить именно оригинальные A–E.

text:
Scenario: A QA engineer at a bank needs a basis for regression and exploratory tests for the story 'Block a lost card'.
Question: Which source should she rely on first?
options: The persona's long template.
The story's acceptance criteria.
The sprint burndown chart.
The story's title on the card.
The product vision statement.
explanation: Acceptance criteria задают ожидаемое поведение и границы конкретной истории, поэтому служат основой тестирования. Персона описывает пользователя, burndown — оставшуюся работу, title — краткую цель, vision — направление продукта; они не заменяют условия приёмки.

text:
Scenario: An analyst lists activities on a digital-services project that will change once the team starts working with user stories.
Question: Which activity is directly affected by user stories?
options: Sprint retrospective.
Pair programming.
Critical path calculation.
Product roadmap.
Earned value analysis.
explanation: User stories связаны с roadmap: помогают представить потребности и ценность, дробить инициативы и планировать развитие продукта. В перечне из лекции к связанным работам относятся roadmap, refinement, decomposition и elaboration. Другие варианты не являются прямым ответом на этот список.

text:
Scenario: In a student portal backlog, most stories look like 'As a student, I need a PDF export button.' The 'so that' part is usually left out.
Question: Which limitation of user stories does this reflect?
options: Giving too much detail on the user role.
Writing too few stories to fill the backlog.
Focusing on the WHAT while overlooking the WHY.
Making stories too dependent on each other.
Relying too heavily on persona differentiators.
explanation: Функция описана, но её польза потеряна: WHAT есть, WHY нет. Фраза so that связывает запрос с результатом для пользователя. Без неё легко поставлять кнопки и отчёты, не проверяя, какую потребность они удовлетворяют.
